name: ask-replay
title: Holding back a question the archive may answer

conditions.method: every question agents had really asked was replayed as of the moment it was asked, and a judge compared the earlier turns it found with the answer the person then gave
conditions.source: the author's own session archive; only counts leave it

summary: A hook that stopped an agent's question once when the person seemed to have answered it before. Most questions agents ask are new decisions, so the hook was removed.

metrics.label: Questions it would have held back
Firings where the earlier turns held the answer then given
Firings where they held a conflicting answer

bar: at least 60% holding the answer and at most 10% conflicting
baseline: the answer the person actually gave each time
meaning: The idea failed clearly. Three in four firings were irrelevant and one in twelve pointed at a conflicting answer, so the hook was removed before it shipped.
